audit.whatIsWrong: Every difficulty-bearing field called Naafiri 'he/his', and the lane's actual difficulty driver — a lock-on ultimate that cannot be dodged — was described as something you read and step around.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists naafiri as female. Hounds' Pursuit is a 900-range targeted dash at a champion; there is no skillshot to sidestep, so 'read it before every step forward' is the wrong instruction. The real answer is banking W for what happens after it lands.
audit.corrected: Rewrote tldr, winCon, enemyWin, loading, ahead, trading and the cooldown field around the lock-on and the untargetable windows, with female pronouns. Left diff TRICKY / 7 / 7.5 alone — see notes on the 50.56% tension.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike was written as 'Eviscerate is her execute' and 'Between Worlds dodges her Eviscerate execute' (whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.you[2], wants.foe[1], content mid).
audit.why: Eviscerate (E) is 11/10/9/8/7 on a 450 range: 'Naafiri dashes and damages enemies in an area around her, recalling her packmates and fully healing them.' No execute flag and no execute in Riot's text. The level 6 ability is Hounds' Pursuit (R), 110/95/80 at 900 range, which recasts once for a shield.
audit.corrected: Her 6 is a lock-on dash with a second cast that shields, not an execute; your 6 answers it after it lands. Eviscerate is a short dash that recalls and heals her packmates.

audit.whatIsWrong: Aurora's Q was twice called a 'gap-close' / 'reposition tool' (spikes[0].text, content mid, wants.you[0]), and the decisive interaction — three separate untargetable windows on the enemy — never appeared anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Aurora Q is a 900-range missile with a recast and carries only the projectile flag; the dash is W (700 range, 22/21/20/19/18). Naafiri's W, E and R all carry the untargetable flag, so a timed Q recast or R can land on nothing at all.
audit.corrected: Written in: W (26/24/22/20/18) and E (11s at rank 1) and R all go untargetable, so hold the recast until she reappears; Q's packmates leap onto the first champion the daggers hit, so dodging the Q keeps the dogs off you; E recalls and fully heals the packmates, which undoes chip on the pack; R recasts for a shield, so plan for two dashes.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit — defect-catalogue item 3 — and asserted that standing near minions body-blocks the hounds.
audit.why: Hounds' Pursuit is described as 'Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion', i.e. targeted. Whether minions can intercept the packmate dashes is not in Riot's text, and minion-block is explicitly listed as something the kit files cannot answer.
audit.corrected: Real numbers only: R 110/95/80, E 11s at rank 1, W 26s, your W 22s. The minion body-block claim was removed rather than reworded — I could not verify it and will not assert it.

audit.whatIsWrong: All three flagged missing interactions were absent: untargetable-through-your-commit, the packmate healing, and the R shield absorbing your burst.
audit.corrected: Untargetable windows now appear in enemyWin, breakdown.mid, whys[1] and spikes[3]; the packmate heal in ahead, dontsFull[2].d and spikes[1]; the recast shield in breakdown.late, report[5].t and content late.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string pasted under 'Fight near your R zone's exit edge', and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string pasted under 'Greed the recast at half HP'. dosFull[2].d told the reader to wait for Naafiri to whiff an ability that cannot whiff.
audit.why: Copy-paste bleed, defect-catalogue item 2; and a targeted dash has no miss state.
audit.corrected: Each body rewritten to answer its own title.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text spiked on 'a defensive or mobility item spike' — placeholder phrasing, defect-catalogue item 7 — and report[8] said 'anti-heal early into his sustain'.
audit.why: The page's own itemization names Luden's, Sorcerer's, Shadowflame, Rabadon's and Zhonya's; and Naafiri is female.
audit.corrected: Named the actual items; pronoun fixed in report[8].

audit.whatIsWrong: LEVEL CHART DISAGREEMENT across all seven rows: phases[0..3].side read 'Naafiri' and phases[4..6].side read 'Skill', while content win[0..6] all read 'Aurora'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Aurora x7, win[] is Aurora x7, and every phases[N].why already describes Aurora winning that stage — three layers agree and only phases[N].side dissents.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side flipped to 'Aurora' as one atomic group. whys[] rewritten in the same pass to stay Aurora-favouring on grounded reasons rather than the vague 'her damage is low' phrasing.

audit.why: 50.56% over 2041 games. No edit; see notes for the tension with diffRating 7/10.

notes: CHART: phases[0..3].side read 'Naafiri' and phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while content win[0..6] all read 'Aurora' — all seven rows rendering two answers. Resolved toward Aurora (packet.levelChart Aurora x7, win[] Aurora x7, and all seven phases[N].why already Aurora-favouring). No win[] edits proposed because win[] is already correct on disk; the seven side flips are the atomic group. FACTUAL ERROR FIXED IN FIVE PLACES: Eviscerate was called 'her execute' in whys[4], spikes[1].text, wants.you[2], wants.foe[1] and content mid. It is a 450-range dash that recalls and fully heals her packmates — no execute flag, no execute in Riot's text. The level 6 threat is Hounds' Pursuit, a targeted 900-range dash that recasts for a shield. The old advice 'dodge her execute with Between Worlds' was teaching the reader to dodge an ability that cannot miss. SECOND ERROR: Aurora's Q was called a gap-close / reposition tool in three places; the dash is W. CLAIM REMOVED, NOT REWORDED: the old cooldowns field and dosFull[0].d told the reader to 'stand near minions to body-block the hounds'. Minion-block is one of the things the kit files explicitly cannot answer and Riot's text says only that Naafiri and her packmates dash at a champion, so I dropped the claim rather than restate it. REVEAL NUANCE NOT ASSERTED: the R carries a revealsStealth flag, but Riot's text conditions the reveal on scoring a takedown. Since Aurora's W grants invisibility this is potentially a major interaction, but I would be guessing about whether it reveals a W that is already active, so nothing was written about it — see questionsForUser. TENSION LEFT ALONE: diff TRICKY / diffRating 7/10 / carryRating 7.5/10 against a 50.56% win rate over 2041 games. Both are defensible (an unmissable lock-on all-in is hard to play against even at an even win rate), so I did not touch the enum fields.
